citations.name: requirements.sdk.domain
citations.commentary:
An *application domain* is the application's graph, node contents, and evidence
storage, made available together for criterion execution. In the SDK, it
implements [`Domain`](../rustdocs/trust_but_verify/domain/trait.Domain.html) to supply
its shared types, node and edge operations, and evidence persistence.

rationale: The commentary block in `md/requirements/sdk.md` (inside the `application_domain` definition) cites `requirements.sdk.domain` with `{cite}`. That is the right role for explanatory prose. Its claims agree with the requirement. The requirement says every application domain implements `trust_but_verify::domain::Domain`. The trait supplies shared types (`Error`, `NodeId`, `NodeContent`, `EdgeLabel`), node and edge operations (`node_path`, `node_content`, `outgoing_edges`), and evidence persistence (`load_evidence`, `store_evidence`). The wording "graph, node contents, and evidence storage, made available together for criterion execution" is the definition's own prose, and it fits the trait members. The block has no `{impl}` or `{test}` reference to the same requirement, so the citation is not redundant.
